name: Ben-Geber
title: Solomon's district governor in Ramoth in Gilead
summary: Ben-Geber was one of Solomon's twelve district governors and was responsible for Ramoth in Gilead, including the associated towns and territories in Bashan.

keyEvents.title: District governor under Solomon
keyEvents.description: Ben-Geber was responsible for Ramoth in Gilead and Jair's tent cities in Bashan among Solomon's district governors.
